rows.path: Hermes browser / Cua Driver / Bot Screen
rows.browser: Documented local and cloud backends; inspect any local sidecar behavior.
rows.desktop: Documented Linux X11/Wayland paths with display, AT-SPI and capture prerequisites.
rows.scope: Current upstream feature docs; exact Hermes/Cua pin required. Native Wayland is opt-in, with documented capture/XWayland caveats. Bot Screen is provider-owned headless Xfce/TigerVNC.
rows.implementation: Prefer a qualified upstream Bot Screen when included in the pin; otherwise qualify the selected existing-display path. Preserve private egress and do not infer same-UID isolation.

rows.browser: Separate browser prelude is documented; browser runtime/helper still needs its own test.
rows.desktop: Versioned docs describe Linux X11 input/capture and conditional Wayland support.
rows.scope: Upstream release-binary capture limits differ from the baseline-referenced Nix build enabling wayland-pipewire. Neither establishes compositor/portal success.
rows.implementation: Qualify exact compiled features, permissions and capabilities on each display backend. Keep computer use off until selected; no generic Wayland pass from X11 results.
